# cellgeni/multiqc

## Summary

Runs [MultiQC](https://docs.seqera.io/multiqc) over a set of files and writes one HTML report per
`meta` map, so a pipeline can build one report per sample group and publish it by `meta`.
The files can be outputs of tools MultiQC supports, or custom content: `*_mqc.json`, `*_mqc.yaml`,
`*_mqc.tsv` tables and plots, `*_mqc.png` images.

The outputs always have the same names, `multiqc_report.html` and `multiqc_data/`, even when the
config sets a report title (which would otherwise rename them). Pipelines can publish them without
knowing the config.

Container: `quay.io/biocontainers/multiqc:1.35--pyhdfd78af_2`.

## Inputs

| Name | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `meta` | map | Metadata of the report, passed through to the outputs. Must contain `id`, which tags the task, e.g. `[id: 'dataset1']`. |
| `multiqc_files` | files | Files for MultiQC to search, staged under `multiqc_input/`. A tuple with `meta`: `[meta, [files]]`. |
| `multiqc_config` | file | Optional MultiQC config YAML, shared by every report. Pass `[]` to use MultiQC's defaults. |

## Outputs

`report` and `data` are tuples of `meta` and the file.

| Name | File(s) | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `report` | `multiqc_report.html` | The report. |
| `data` | `multiqc_data/` | Parsed data, plot data and logs behind the report. |
| `versions` | `versions.yml` | MultiQC version. |

## Configuration via `ext` variables

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ext.args` | string | `""` | Extra MultiQC arguments, e.g. `"--title 'My run' --comment 'Batch 3'"`. `--force`, `--filename` and `--config` are set by the module. A closure can use `meta`, e.g. `{ "--title '${meta.id}'" }`. |

## Usage

```nextflow
include { MULTIQC } from 'cellgeni/multiqc'

MULTIQC(
    channel.fromPath('qc/*_mqc.*').collect().map { files -> [[id: 'all'], files] },
    file('assets/multiqc_config.yaml')   // or [] for defaults
)
```

## License

MIT

// Aggregates MultiQC input files (tool outputs or *_mqc custom content) of one report, named by meta.id,
// into an HTML report
process MULTIQC {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    container 'quay.io/biocontainers/multiqc:1.35--pyhdfd78af_2'

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(multiqc_files, stageAs: 'multiqc_input/*')
    path multiqc_config  // optional: pass [] to use MultiQC's defaults

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("multiqc_report.html"), emit: report
    tuple val(meta), path("multiqc_data"),        emit: data
    path "versions.yml",                          emit: versions

    script:
    def args   = task.ext.args ?: ''
    def config = multiqc_config ? "--config ${multiqc_config}" : ''
    """
    # MultiQC builds the report in a temporary folder and then moves it here. Keep that folder
    # inside the work directory, so the move stays on one filesystem and the outputs inherit
    # the work directory's group (a copy from /tmp gets the user's primary group instead)
    export TMPDIR=\$PWD/.multiqc_tmp
    mkdir -p \$TMPDIR

    multiqc \\
        --force \\
        --filename multiqc_report.html \\
        ${config} \\
        ${args} \\
        multiqc_input

    # The data folder is named after the report file; keep a fixed name for the output
    if [[ -d multiqc_report_data ]]; then mv multiqc_report_data multiqc_data; fi
    rm -rf \$TMPDIR

    cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        multiqc: \$(multiqc --version | sed 's/.*version //')
    END_VERSIONS
    """

    stub:
    """
    mkdir multiqc_data
    touch multiqc_report.html

    cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml
    "${task.process}":
        multiqc: \$(multiqc --version | sed 's/.*version //')
    END_VERSIONS
    """
}

$schema: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nextflow-io/schemas/refs/heads/main/module/v1/schema.json
name: cellgeni/multiqc
version: 0.2.0
description: >
  Aggregates tool outputs and MultiQC custom content (*_mqc.* files) into an HTML report per meta
  map, with a fixed output layout (multiqc_report.html and multiqc_data/) whatever the report title.
keywords:
  - multiqc
  - qc
  - report
  - custom content
license: MIT
authors:
  - "@claptar"
maintainers:
  - "@claptar"
requires:
  nextflow: ">=25.04.0"
tools:
  - multiqc:
      description: "Aggregate results from bioinformatics analyses across many samples into a single report."
      homepage: "https://seqera.io/multiqc/"
      documentation: "https://docs.seqera.io/multiqc"
      tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/MultiQC/MultiQC"
      doi: "10.1093/bioinformatics/btw354"
      licence:
        - "GPL-3.0-or-later"
input:
  - - name: meta
      type: map
      description: "Map with metadata of the report, e.g. the group of samples it covers. Must contain key 'id', e.g. [ id:'dataset1' ]"
    - name: multiqc_files
      type: file
      description: "Files for MultiQC to search: tool outputs and/or custom content (*_mqc.json, *_mqc.tsv, *_mqc.png, ...). Staged under multiqc_input/."
  - name: multiqc_config
    type: file
    description: "Optional MultiQC config YAML (report title, section order, custom content settings). Pass [] to use the defaults."
    pattern: "*.{yml,yaml}"
output:
  - - name: meta
      type: map
      description: "Map with report metadata, passed through from input."
    - name: report
      type: file
      description: "The MultiQC HTML report."
      pattern: "multiqc_report.html"
  - - name: meta
      type: map
      description: "Map with report metadata, passed through from input."
    - name: data
      type: directory
      description: "Parsed data, plot data and logs behind the report."
      pattern: "multiqc_data"
  - name: versions
    type: file
    description: "YAML file recording the MultiQC version."
    pattern: "versions.yml"
